مَرْأًى : see رِئْىٌ ―
-b2- You say also, هُوَ مِنِّى مَرْأًى وَمَسْمَعٌ, and مَرْأًى وَمَسْمَعًا, (M, K,) accord. to Sb, as adv. ns. having a special, or particularized, meaning, used as though they had not such a meaning, (M,) and sometimes they said مَرًى, (TA in art. سمع,) He is where I see him and hear him. (M, K.) And فُلَانٌ مِنِّى بِمَرْأًى وَمَسْمَعٍ Such a one is where I see him and hear what he says. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
